in_sanskrit.name: कार्तिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is instrumental in doing good deeds

in_marathi.name: Karthika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karthika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kartika’, meaning ‘the night’. This name holds deep significance in Hindu mythology, as it is associated with the goddess Kartikeya, also known as Murugan or Skanda, who is the god of war and the son of Lord Shiva.

in_bengali.name: Karthika

This name holds deep significance in Hindu mythology, as it is associated with the goddess Kartikeya, also known as Murugan or Skanda, who is the god of war and the son of Lord Shiva.
